sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Obstacle is an arcade-style game that requires players to navigate through levels while avoiding obstacles and accumulating points. The game's controls are simple and intuitive, allowing players to use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play. The game's objective is to navigate through each level without touching any of the obstacles, which are placed strategically throughout the level.

As players progress through the levels, the obstacles become increasingly difficult to avoid, requiring players to think strategically and react quickly to succeed.
